==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Exclusive}} unit. He is a [[Tournament|Tournament-exclusive]] (preceding [[Wukong]] and succeeding [[Stitches]]), only obtainable by clearing the tournament on the 99.00% ~ 99.89% ranking reward, with his shiny being the 99.90% ~ 100% ranking reward.
